prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1270; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the shop following a low-speed head-on impact. The front bumper cover is cracked and displaced, the radiator support shows bending consistent with a frontal hit, and the hood latch and both headlight assemblies are damaged. Crush pattern and paint transfer line up with the reported collision, and no prior damage to this vehicle is known or visible on the panels. The proposed repair plan replaces the bumper cover, hood latch, and affected lamps, straightens the support, and refinishes the front end. Labor hours are in line with the work described. Invoices submitted show a single charge for each line item, with nothing duplicated.
